text: Yes, paused at a checkpoint, not stopped. Done and compiling: the API lights (green/amber/grey), tap for the error, and Test now on each API card. Not shipped yet. Next: the Try again button (needs an engine-side request that wakes one API without touching the scan), tests, then the cross-exchange paper detection, shipped together as one release. Tell me if you want the lights released on their own first.
